checks.summary: JS SYNTAX OK (node v24.18.0, syntax check only -- no execution, no browser). The added script uses only fetch against this origin's own /v1/repositories, document.createElement and textContent; it loads no provider SDK, no external asset and no remote font or script, and it reads no credential-bearing field. Rendering uses textContent rather than innerHTML throughout, so a locator or a reason string cannot become markup. The existing Content-Security-Policy header (default-src 'self') is unchanged and is what makes the no-external-asset property enforced rather than merely intended.

checks.name: executability-is-rendered-as-measured-or-unobserved
checks.summary: The list renders, per Repository: the opaque repository_id, the locator as forge:host/owner/name@default_branch, the status and version, then 'loop executable: yes|no [state]' with the state name from the closed set and the measured reason underneath. When the response carries no executability field the renderer substitutes the explicit state 'unobserved' with the reason 'the response carried no executability field' rather than rendering a blank or a guess, and a stale observation is labelled '(stale observation)'. The section's own caption states that a field with no measurement is shown as its explicit unobserved state and reason, never as a plausible value.
